name: Bananas Simmered In Jasmine Scented Coconut Milk
instructions: Peel the bananas just before you are ready to cook them
In a sauce pan , heat the coconut milk
Add sugar to the desired sweetness and a little bit of salt
The salt enhances the rich creamy taste of coconut milk , especially if you are using canned milk
Sprinkle in a few drops of mali essence , if you wish a delicatae floral scent in the background
When the mixture is hot and smooth , add the bananas and simmer about 5 minutes , or until the bananas are cooked but still in whole pieces
